integrity: Classical ingredients attributed to prior authors. New contribution confined to the global conditional leaf profile, its cubic-root mode, finite strict covariance sign and leading coefficient. Finite code checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled trees n>=3; full conditional mean not the full conditional distribution; asymptotic limits are analytic, independent replication/audit not performed; possible implicit earlier coverage in inaccessible classical tree-enumeration literature.
title: A cubic-root peak in conditional leaf counts of uniform Cayley trees
